lines.beaver_en: Hello, this is the ticket office. How can I help you?
lines.en: I want to book tickets for Saturday's concert.

lines.beaver: 네, 토요일 저녁 일곱 시 공연이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Sure, it's the Saturday 7 p.m. show.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, toyoil jeonyeok ilgop si gongyeonieyo.

lines.learner: 와, 기대돼요! 바이올린 소리를 듣고 싶어요.
lines.en: Wow, I can't wait! I want to hear the violin.
lines.roman: wa, gidaedwaeyo! baiollin sorireul deutgo sipeoyo.

lines.en: I like the guitar. I'm really looking forward to it.

lines.beaver_en: There are good seats. Shall I give you front seats?
lines.en: Yes, front seats, please. How much is a ticket?

lines.learner: 두 장 주세요. 친구하고 같이 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: Two, please. I want to see it with a friend.
lines.roman: du jang juseyo. chinguhago gachi bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Here are your tickets. Nice design, right?
lines.learner: 네, 디자인이 정말 예뻐요. 누가 그렸어요?
lines.en: Yes, the design is really pretty. Who drew it?
lines.roman: ne, dijaini jeongmal yeppeoyo. nuga geuryeosseoyo?

lines.en: Wow, that's cool. I like paintings.

lines.beaver_en: There's also a painting exhibition next month.
lines.en: I want to book that exhibition too.

lines.beaver: 네, 다음 주부터 예매할 수 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Sure, you can book it from next week.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, daeum jubuteo yemaehal su isseoyo.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 다음 주에 매표소에 또 올게요.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll come to the ticket office again next week.
lines.roman: gamsahamnida. daeum jue maepyosoe tto olgeyo.
